item.title: Men's HIL: Tom Boon’s Five-goal Masterclass Powers Ranchi Royals To A 6-2 Win Over SG Pipers
item.description: Ranchi Royals delivered a dominant performance in their Men’s Hockey India League (HIL) clash against SG Pipers, riding on an extraordinary five-goal haul from captain Tom Boon to register a comprehensive 6-2 victory and underline their attacking prowess in front of their home crowd at the Marang Gomke Astro Turf Hockey Stadium in Ranchi on Wednesday.

item.title: Mumbai Indians vs UP Warriorz, Match 8, WPL 2026, Who will win today MI-W vs UPW-W match?
item.description: Mumbai Indians Women vs UP Warriorz Women will take on each other in the next game of the tournament on Thursday at Dr. DY Patil Sports Academy.

item.title: Indian Cyclists Touch Down In Pune Ahead Of Historic Pune Grand Tour 2026
item.description: CFI Secretary General Maninder Pal: The Indian cycling team touched down in Pune on Wednesday for the Pune Grand Tour 2026, India’s first-ever UCI 2.2 category multi-stage Continental Road Cycling Race for Men, marking a landmark moment for the sport in the country.

item.title: ‘Pathway For Future Stars...': ICC Chief Jay Shah Wishes Luck To Teams For U19 World Cup
item.description: The International Cricket Council: The International Cricket Council (ICC) chair Jay Shah extended his best wishes to the U19 stars for kickstarting their World Cup campaign in Zimbabwe and Namibia.

item.title: Arsenal Edge Thriller To Take Narrow SF Lead Over Chelsea
item.description: Ben White: Ben White, Viktor Gyokeres and Martin Zubimendi helped Arsenal take a one-goal advantage into the second leg after a breathless 3-2 victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge in the Carabao Cup semi-finals.

item.title: Pakistan to Host Australia for Three T20Is Ahead of World Cup Preparations
item.description: Former champions Pakistan and Australia will face each other in a three-match T20I series in Lahore from January 29 to February 1 as part of their preparations for the upcoming Twenty20 World Cup co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka.

item.title: Arbeloa Debuts With Loss As Albacete Knock Real Madrid Out Of Copa Del Rey
item.description: Carlos Belmonte Stadium: Alvaro Arbeloa's debut as Real Madrid coach ended in a shock exit from the Copa del Rey after a 3-2 defeat away to second-tier Albacete.

item.title: DC Could've Taken More Responsibility To Avoid Taking Game Deep: Wolvaardt
item.description: After Delhi Capitals: After Delhi Capitals opened their account in the Women’s Premier League 2026 with a seven-wicket win against UP Warriorz, batter Laura Wolvaardt reflected on a tense finish, saying the team could have taken a bit more responsibility to avoid taking the game deep.

item.title: Aus Open: Djokovic, Sinner In Same Half Of Draw; Alcaraz To Start Against Home Hope Walton
item.description: On Wednesday Kokkinakis: The 24-time Grand Slam champion Novak Djokovic and Jannik Sinner have been drawn in the same half of the Australian Open singles draw, which was revealed Thursday.

item.title: WPL 2026: Delhi Bowlers Claw Back After Lanning–Deol Stand Lifts UP Warriorz To 154/8
item.description: DY Patil Stadium: After absorbing strong pressure from a fluent partnership between skipper Meg Lanning and Harleen Deol, Delhi Capitals produced a disciplined bowling performance to claw their way back and restricted UP Warriorz to a competitive but less than commanding total of 154 for 8 in the seventh match of the Women's Premier League (WPL) 2026 at the Dr. DY Patil Stadium in Navi Mumbai.
